rtnl_lock() is used everywhere
When someone wants to iterate over alive net namespaces
he/she has no a possibility to do that without exclusive lock.
But the exclusive rtnl_lock() in such places is overkill
and it just increases the contention. Yes
for_each_net_rcu() in kernel
and this can't be sleepable. Also
really prevent net_namespace_list growth
is not fit there.
This patch introduces new rw_semaphore
instead of rtnl_mutex to protect net_namespace_list. It is
sleepable and allows not-exclusive iterations over net
namespaces list. It allows to stop using rtnl_lock()
in several places (what is made in next patches) and makes
less the time
